rounds.name: a1
rounds.summary: The second copy of the scans.

questions.text: Should the nightly backup also copy the Juneau archive to the second disk?
background: The family photo scans live on one disk today, and the second disk has 30 GB free.
A second copy was turned down in the spring, and a yes here replaces ruling r-0042.

causes.yes: Each night's backup runs 15 minutes longer, and the scans survive a failed disk.
causes.no: The backup stays at 40 minutes a night, and one failed disk loses every scan.

questions.reason: The scans can't be made again, because the Sitka library returned the originals.
